translationRepairs: 吳達禮自鎭守盛京昂邦將軍爲鎭守遼東等處將軍.
Wu Dali was transferred from Angbang General at Shengjing to General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places.
s0027 is untranslated Chinese; 自鎭守盛京昂邦將軍爲鎭守遼東等處將軍 records Wu Dali’s move from Shengjing Angbang General to Liaodong General, matching the proposed idiomatic.
吳達禮自鎭守盛京昂邦將軍爲鎭守遼東等處將軍.
Wu Dali, from Angbang General garrisoning Shengjing, became General for Garrisoning Liaodong and Other Places.
The literal before is still Chinese; 自…爲 is accurately rendered as from Shengjing Angbang General becoming Liaodong General, without inventing agents or dates.
巴海順治十六年以昂邦將軍駐防是年陞鎭守寧古塔等處將軍.
Bahai had garrisoned as Angbang General since Shunzhi 16; this year he was promoted to General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places.
s0028 needs translation, but the proposal’s “that year” after Shunzhi 16 wrongly dates 是年陞 to Shunzhi 16. Under s0026’s Kangxi-1 creation of the Ningguta post, 是年 is this year; revise accordingly.
巴海順治十六年以昂邦將軍駐防是年陞鎭守寧古塔等處將軍.
Bahai, from Shunzhi 16 as Angbang General on garrison duty, was this year promoted to General for Garrisoning Ningguta and Other Places.
Literal must translate the Chinese, but “promoted that year” binds 是年 to Shunzhi 16. Context s0026 shows the Ningguta generalship began in Kangxi 1, so 是年 is this year.
Sabusu moved his seat to Mergen.
s0729 is untranslated; 薩布素移駐墨爾根 means Sabusu moved his seat to Mergen, which the idiomatic states completely and naturally.
Sabusu moved his headquarters to Mergen.
移駐墨爾根 is a transfer of garrison seat/headquarters to Mergen; the proposed literal is accurate and does not invent content.
費揚古爲安北將軍駐歸化城.
Fiyanggu was made Anbei General, stationed at Guihuacheng.
s0805 費揚古爲安北將軍，駐歸化城 is untranslated; the idiomatic correctly makes him Anbei General stationed at Guihuacheng.
費揚古爲安北將軍駐歸化城.
Fiyanggu became Anbei General, garrisoned at Guihuacheng.
爲安北將軍，駐歸化城 is became Anbei General, garrisoned at Guihuacheng; the literal matches without omission or invention.
Sabusu moved his seat to Qiqihar.
s0954 is untranslated Chinese; 移駐齊齊哈爾 means Sabusu moved his seat to Qiqihar, as proposed.
Sabusu moved his headquarters to Qiqihar.
移駐齊齊哈爾 is a headquarters move to Qiqihar; the literal repair is accurate and complete.
zh is the name 托留; “托 was retained” invents a retention verb from 留. Neighboring cells are bare names, so “Tuoliu.” is the correct repair.
s1478 巴賽署寧古塔將軍 is untranslated; 署 marks an acting appointment, and the idiomatic renders that cleanly.
Basai served as acting Ningguta General.
署寧古塔將軍 means served as acting Ningguta General; the literal matches the Chinese without added dates or agents.
Danai was assigned to manage Qinghai affairs.
s1632 is untranslated; 達鼐辦理青海事務 means Danai was assigned to manage Qinghai affairs, as proposed.
辦理青海事務 is handled Qinghai affairs; the literal is a faithful, complete rendering of the Chinese.
僧格瑪臘 concatenates two ministers; s1758 separates 僧格 and 瑪臘, so “Sengge and Mala.” correctly splits the fused cell.
The fused 僧格瑪臘 are two names, confirmed when s1758 lists 僧格…瑪臘 apart; the literal split is required.
Same fused pair 僧格瑪臘 as in s1708; splitting into Sengge and Mala matches the two-person pattern in later Tibet cells.
Literal must split 僧格瑪臘 into Sengge and Mala; leaving them fused would invent a single name.
僧格回京. 青保駐藏辦事. 瑪臘.
Sengge returned to the capital. Qingbao served as resident minister in Tibet. Mala.
s1758 has three clauses: 僧格回京, 青保駐藏辦事, and name 瑪臘. The idiomatic translates each without fusing names or inventing offices.
僧格回京. 青保駐藏辦事. 瑪臘.
Sengge returned to the capital. Qingbao was stationed in Tibet handling affairs. Mala.
The Chinese needs translation, but “garrisoned Tibet on official business” militarily overreads 駐藏辦事. Keep Sengge’s return and Mala’s name, and render 駐藏辦事 as stationed in Tibet handling affairs.
In the sixth month, 青保瑪臘 was summoned back to the capital. 苗壽: Resident Minister in Tibet.
In the sixth month, Qingbao and Mala were summoned back to the capital. Miaoshou: Resident Minister in Tibet.
青保瑪臘六月召回京 and 苗壽駐藏辦事 require splitting Qingbao and Mala and translating Miaoshou; the proposed idiomatic does both accurately.
Celing was made Dingbian Left Vice General.
s1806 is untranslated; 策凌爲定邊左副將軍 means Celing was made Dingbian Left Vice General, matching the idiomatic.
Celing became Dingbian Left Vice General.
爲定邊左副將軍 is became Dingbian Left Vice General; the literal repair is complete and accurate.
青保苗壽 fuses two names already separate in s1758/s1783; “Qingbao and Miaoshou.” correctly splits them.
Literal likewise must split 青保苗壽 into Qingbao and Miaoshou rather than leave a fused form.
s1833 repeats fused 青保苗壽; splitting to Qingbao and Miaoshou matches the established two-minister reading.
Same fused cell as s1808; the literal “Qingbao and Miaoshou.” is the required split.
那蘇圖 was transferred. 覺羅柏修爲奉天將軍.
Nasutu was transferred. Jueluo Baixiu was appointed Fengtian General.
s1877 mixes English and Chinese; 那蘇圖遷 and 覺羅柏修爲奉天將軍 are Nasutu transferred and Jueluo Baixiu appointed Fengtian General.
塔爾岱 was transferred. 那蘇圖爲黑龍江將軍.
Ta'erdai was transferred. Nasutu was appointed Heilongjiang General.
s1879’s remaining Chinese 那蘇圖爲黑龍江將軍 (with 塔爾岱遷) is correctly completed as Ta'erdai transferred and Nasutu appointed Heilongjiang General.
